# Daniel Caesar Horology

> Independent luxury watch maison. Bilingual (English / Persian) showroom presenting Daniel Caesar timepieces organised by style (Dress, Sport, Chronograph, Skeleton) and features (automatic movement, power reserve, case material, water resistance, sapphire crystal). Every watch carries a QR-based digital warranty.

## Main pages
- [Home](/): featured Meridian 41, collections and after-care
- [Watches](/watches): full showroom with style and feature filters
- [The Maison](/brand): brand story, philosophy and craftsmanship
- [Journal](/journal): stories on design, craft and care
- [Authorised retailers](/retailers): official boutiques and partners
- [Contact](/contact): concierge, private viewings, after-care
- [Warranty](/warranty): verify a serial number (format DC-YYYY-0000)

## Collections
- Meridian 41 — Dress, 41 mm titanium, DC-01 automatic, 72 h reserve, 100 m
- Aurelius 38 — Dress, 38 mm steel, DC-02 automatic, 48 h reserve, 50 m
- Voyager 42 — Sport, 42 mm steel, DC-03 automatic, 60 h reserve, 300 m
- Vesper Chronograph — Chronograph, 42 mm steel, DC-C1 automatic, 60 h reserve
- Nocturne Skeleton — Skeleton, 40 mm titanium, DC-S1 manual, 55 h reserve

## Notes
- Watches are sold only through authorised retailers; there is no online checkout.
- Warranty: 10 years from activation.
